description: Find PubChem bioassays associated with a biological target. Search by gene symbol (e.g. "EGFR"), protein name, NCBI Gene ID, or UniProt accession. Returns a page of assay IDs (AIDs) — page past maxResults with offset — which can be explored further with pubchem_get_summary.

maxResults.description: Max AIDs to return per page (1-200). Popular targets may have thousands of assays; use offset to reach the ones past this page. Default: 50.

offset.description: Zero-based index of the first AID to return. Pass the nextOffset from a previous call to read the following page. Default: 0.

targetQuery.description: Target identifier. Examples: "EGFR" (genesymbol), "Epidermal growth factor receptor" (proteinname), "1956" (geneid), "P00533" (proteinaccession).

targetType.description: Target identifier type. "genesymbol" and "proteinname" accept text names. "geneid" accepts NCBI Gene IDs. "proteinaccession" accepts UniProt accessions.

name: pubchem_search_assays

cap.description: The maxResults cap that was applied.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `blank_target_query`: targetQuery is empty or whitespace-only. `invalid_geneid_query`: targetType is "geneid" but targetQuery contains characters other than digits. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

nextOffset.description: Offset to pass on the next call to continue past this page. Omitted when no further AIDs match.

notice.description: Recovery guidance when no assays matched, when the offset runs past the result set, or when further pages remain. Absent when this page is complete and non-empty.

offset.description: Zero-based index of the first AID returned.

targetType.description: Target identifier type used: genesymbol, proteinname, geneid, or proteinaccession.

totalFound.description: Total AIDs found for this target, across all pages.

truncated.description: True when matching AIDs remain past this page.

title: Search Assays
